s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive painful skin lesions and ulcers with systemic symptoms and laboratory abnormalities
salient_findings: Progressive, painful blisters and ulcers of the groin
Enlargement of the tongue with difficulty with mastication
Numbness without weakness of the distal lower limbs
key_facts: 1-week history of progressive, painful blisters and ulcers of the groin
3-month history of tongue enlargement leading to difficulty with mastication
3-month history of numbness without weakness of the distal lower limbs
History of IgG λ-type multiple myeloma complicated by anemia and lytic lesions in the calvarium
Patient is taking folic acid and intramuscular cyanocobalamin supplements due to deficiencies
Circinate purpuric patches with erosions on the natal cleft, buttocks, inguinal creases, and vulva
Hemorrhagic flaccid bullae on the posterior perineum
Macroglossia, glossitis, and a hemorrhagic erosion on the hard palate
Purpuric macules present periorbitally, on the lips, inframammary folds, forearms, and thighs
Low serum zinc level
Subepidermal blister lined by fibrin and chronic inflammatory infiltrate with scattered short eosinophilic bands in the dermis
Apple-green birefringence on polarized light microscopy with Congo red staining

trace.fact: 1-week history of progressive, painful blisters and ulcers of the groin

rule_in.why: it is associated with blistering skin lesions

rule_out.why: Scurvy typically presents with perifollicular petechiae and corkscrew hairs, not painful blisters and ulcers

trace.fact: 3-month history of tongue enlargement leading to difficulty with mastication

rule_in.why: it is commonly associated with tongue enlargement

rule_out.why: tongue enlargement is not typical of scurvy

trace.fact: 3-month history of numbness without weakness of the distal lower limbs

rule_in.why: it often presents with numbness of the distal lower limbs

rule_out.why: it is unrelated to numbness of the lower limbs

trace.fact: History of IgG λ-type multiple myeloma complicated by anemia and lytic lesions in the calvarium

rule_out.why: lytic lesions are not typical of scurvy

trace.fact: Patient is taking folic acid and intramuscular cyanocobalamin supplements due to deficiencies

rule_in.why: the fact does not discriminate between the candidates

rule_out.why: folic acid and cyanocobalamin supplements do not address vitamin C deficiency

trace.fact: Circinate purpuric patches with erosions on the natal cleft, buttocks, inguinal creases, and vulva

rule_in.why: it is associated with specific skin lesions

rule_out.why: Scurvy typically presents with perifollicular petechiae and corkscrew hairs, not purpuric patches with erosions

trace.fact: Hemorrhagic flaccid bullae on the posterior perineum

rule_in.why: it is associated with hemorrhagic bullae

rule_out.why: Scurvy is not typically associated with hemorrhagic bullae

trace.fact: Macroglossia, glossitis, and a hemorrhagic erosion on the hard palate

rule_in.why: it is strongly associated with oral mucosal lesions

rule_out.why: Scurvy is more commonly associated with gingivitis and joint pain
